split_contract.arm_selection_population: inner-selection fold only; this is train-side mechanism selection
split_contract.outer_fold_usage: already-consumed development OOF, evaluated only after selected/latest checkpoints are frozen and never called untouched validation

actor_updates.step_cap_semantics: apply once after all K microsteps; cap only and never enlarge a naturally smaller cumulative round update

pairing.only_registered_difference: number K of Actor optimizer microsteps after each block of 20 Twin-Critic updates

checkpoint_selection: lowest inner absolute Query mean cost; round zero eligible and first minimum wins ties; every registered curve checkpoint also reports warm-relative tail and speed slices

evaluation_contract.primary: deterministic direct center warm-relative gain G_w = J_warm - J_actor
evaluation_contract.round0_relative_role: learning-curve diagnostic only; never a policy qualification metric
evaluation_contract.warm_role: external deterministic Query-evaluated center reference only; never an Actor input, label, weight, anchor, loss, or reward

decision_gate.population: inner selected checkpoints only; outer fold is corroborating consumed development evidence
decision_gate.pass: K4 is the leading small-step long-curve arm; then decide whether K16 is needed without changing LR/trust simultaneously
decision_gate.fail: retain K1 as the small-step cost reference and diagnose refreshed-gradient/ESS before changing model structure

matched_step_routing: the independently validated frozen one-step audit rejected direct enlargement to 0.005/0.01/0.02 sigma; this curve intentionally retains the original 2e-6 small-step refreshed-OAC contract
